stories.title: LEGO invertirá 400 millones de dólares en Nuevo León y generará más de 1,300 empleos

en.title: LEGO will invest 400 million dollars in Nuevo León and generate over 1,300 jobs
en.summary: LEGO plans to invest 400 million dollars to expand its operations in Nuevo León, with the project running until 2029.

stories.title: Juez da ultimátum a la Casa Blanca por veto a CNN, Politico y MS NOW; le pide explicar por qué aún impide el acceso a esos medios

en.title: Judge gives White House ultimatum over veto of CNN, Politico and MS NOW; asks why it still blocks access to those outlets
en.summary: A judge has issued an ultimatum to the White House regarding its restrictions on media outlets CNN, Politico, and MS NOW, demanding explanation for continued access denial.

stories.title: Huracán Polo sigue como categoría 5: Alerta por lluvias, vientos y oleaje en el Pacífico

en.title: Hurricane Polo remains category 5: Alert for rain, winds and waves in the Pacific
en.summary: Hurricane Polo maintains category 5 status over the Pacific, bringing heavy rain, strong winds and high waves to five states.

stories.title: Sheinbaum dice que se siguen revisando los permisos en megadecomiso de combustible en Guanajuato; pide a FGR dar detalles

en.title: Sheinbaum says permits continue to be reviewed in major fuel seizure in Guanajuato; asks FGR for details
en.summary: Mexico's president requested waiting for the attorney general's office to complete its review of all permits related to a major fuel seizure in Guanajuato.

stories.title: Trump recibe a Xi Jinping en la Casa Blanca; dice que tiene una "verdadera gran amistad" con el líder chino

en.title: Trump receives Xi Jinping at the White House; says he has a "true great friendship" with the Chinese leader
en.summary: Trump met with Chinese leader Xi Jinping at the White House and described their relationship as a genuine strong friendship.

stories.title: FGR sigue revisando permisos, dice CSP de presunto huachicol

en.summary: Mexico's government presented a Digital Economy Law aimed at promoting electronic payments, expanding banking access, and formalizing economic activities.

stories.title: Ley de Economía Digital busca reducir uso de efectivo, detalla Pepe Merino; prevé iniciar en gasolineras y carreteras

en.title: Digital Economy Law seeks to reduce cash use, Pepe Merino details; plans to start in gas stations and highways
en.summary: Mexico's president clarified that the new digital economy legislation aims to reduce cash use rather than ban it, with implementation beginning at gas stations and highways.

stories.title: Recibe Trump a Xi en la Casa Blanca

stories.title: Lego anuncia inversión de 400 mdd en México; Ebrard prevé creación de mil 300 empleos en Nuevo León

en.summary: Lego plans a 400 million dollar investment in Mexico expected to create approximately 1,300 jobs in Nuevo León, amid high levels of foreign direct investment.

stories.title: Ordena juez restablecer acceso a medios a Casa Blanca

en.title: Judge Orders Restoration of Media Access to White House
en.summary: A U.S. judge temporarily blocked Trump's ban against three news outlets and ordered that journalists regain access to the White House.

en.summary: Bank statements can serve as evidence of income and payment capacity for certain loan applications when regulatory requirements are met.

stories.title: El SAT quiere "seducir" a micro y pequeñas empresas: ofrece IVA de 7% y eliminar contabilidad para 2027

en.summary: Mexico's tax authority is proposing incentives for small businesses including reduced VAT rates, simplified filing to a single form, and quarterly instead of monthly tax payments.
